# BAD-076 — next dev rewrites admin/CLAUDE.md on every run

## Brief
Running 'npm run dev' in admin/ makes Next 16 append a 10-line <!-- BEGIN:nextjs-agent-rules --> block to admin/CLAUDE.md, so any session that follows admin/README.md's own local-development steps ends up with an unrelated modified guidance file in its diff. A spudagent cannot revert it (it is outside the deliverable glob, and Law 7 forbids git restore), so it silently rides along into whatever PR is open. The repo should decide once: commit the block, point next at a different file, or ignore it.

Evidence: BAD-054 PR 2, worktree bad-054-pr2-usertab: the dev run for section 8 step 6 left 'M admin/CLAUDE.md' with a 10-line append (git diff admin/CLAUDE.md). The generator is admin/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js, which re-adds the block between AGENT_RULES_START_MARKER and AGENT_RULES_END_MARKER whenever next dev starts; its own text says removing it from a diff only re-creates the change. Spud must 'git restore admin/CLAUDE.md' before committing this PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus. The change is two lines of config plus a paragraph of comment in next.config.mjs's established voice, and one line in admin/CLAUDE.md; small, but the config file's comments are long, careful prose that a cheaper tier would not match, and the verification is a real 'npm run dev' run with a git status check on either side of it. Decision (Spud, 2026-09-15): turn the generator off with 'agentRules: false' rather than commit its block or point it at a new AGENTS.md. The schema in next 16.3.4 supports the option (node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js:496), it is the only one of the three that ends the churn permanently, and the block's one piece of real advice — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next code, because this version is not the one in your training data — is worth stating in admin/CLAUDE.md's own words where nothing rewrites it. Committing the block leaves the tree dirty again on every Next upgrade that edits the block text; an AGENTS.md moves the churn rather than ending it and adds a second guidance file to a directory that already has one.
